Release 1.0(113)

Commit: 6f10afa

### New Features

- Per-session notes: attach a note to any terminal session, auto-saved, restorable across restarts, and expandable/foldable from the Info panel (`bd97eb2`, `6f10afa`, `c106f6a`, `89962ba`)

### Improvements

- Tightened sidebar spacing and layout in the Info and Git panels (`89962ba`)
- Removed the TTY metric (`89962ba`)

### Fixes

- OpenCode detection also recognizes `opencode.exe` (`28ff83a`)
